questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 60/12 = 5. Larger = 7 × 5 = 35.

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days and B in 6 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/6 = 18/72. Time = 72/18 = 4 days.

Find 10% of 10% of 1600.
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their difference is 33. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 33, so each part = 11. Smaller = 2 × 11 = 22.

questions.question: A boat travels 48 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 48/3 = 16 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 16 − 3 = 13 km/h.

questions.explanation: Total distance = 120 + 180 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

If today is Thursday, what day will it be after 74 days?
questions.explanation: 74 mod 7 = 4; Thursday + 4 = Monday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 7th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 7th letter = G; 7 + 5 = 12th letter = L.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (4, 65), (2, 8), (7, 343), (8, 512)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 4³ = 64, not 65.

questions.question: In a row of 60 students, Ravi is 18th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 60 − 18 + 1 = 43.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 11, so 28 + 11 = 39.

questions.question: If DOG is coded as GRJ, how is BOOK coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to BOOK gives ERRN.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 6² = 36.

questions.question: A person walks 9 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 8 + 2 × 4.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 8 × 2 − 4 = 16 − 4 = 12.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 19, 39, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2 + 1: 39 × 2 + 1 = 79.

questions.question: Complete the series: F, I, L, O, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is R.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 23, 17, 21, 3
questions.explanation: 17, 23, 3 are prime numbers; 21 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 4th letter from the right is the 23rd from the left = W.
The relation is cubing: 3³ = 27, so 6³ = 216.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 34 days?
questions.explanation: 34 mod 7 = 6; Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 4th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 4th letter = D; 4 + 5 = 9th letter = I.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (4, 64), (7, 343), (3, 25), (2, 8)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 25.

questions.question: In a row of 39 students, Ravi is 13th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 39 − 13 + 1 = 27.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 3, 8, 16, 27, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 14, so 27 + 14 = 41.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 37 + 13 = 50.

questions.question: If DOG is coded as FQI, how is FISH coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to FISH gives HKUJ.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.question: The currency of Japan is the:
questions.explanation: Japan’s currency is the Yen.

questions.question: The currency of the United States is the:
questions.explanation: The US currency is the Dollar.

questions.question: Which is the longest river flowing within India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (~2,525 km) is the longest river within India.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.explanation: It was launched on 8 August 1942.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: The idea of a Preamble was borrowed from the US Constitution.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the Nepal–China border, with its peak in Nepal.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: The study of living organisms is called:
questions.explanation: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is the:
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Which festival is known as the "Festival of Lights"?
questions.explanation: Diwali is the Festival of Lights.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.
